title: A three-agent boundary for sequential consent under correlated costs
checked_scope: Independent three-incumbent extension of the source's two-agent consent model; explicit multiplicity of sequential-equilibrium outcomes under correlated costs.
significance: Constructs and verifies a consistent off-path-belief equilibrium that rejects an all-positive gain profile, plus a welfare-superior equilibrium, locating the two-agent theorem's exact extension boundary.
